title: Super0ptimizati0n
description: A lightweight optimization modpack for Fabric 26.1.2 designed to boost FPS on low-end PCs and laptops.
body:
** Super0ptimizati0n is a deep-optimized Minecraft 26.1.2 modpack designed for maximum performance**, rock-solid FPS, and minimal input latency. This pack transforms a heavy Minecraft client into a highly responsive tool, ensuring every millisecond is optimized for the best possible experience.


Core Features:
1.  Nuclear Optimization: Built using top-tier performance mods (Lithium, Sodium, C2ME, FerriteCore) to eliminate micro-stutters and drastically reduce memory footprint.
   
2.  Engineering Approach: Every config file has been meticulously tuned for modern systems, ensuring stable gameplay even on limited resources.
 
3.  Quality of Life: Includes a curated selection of utility mods (MouseTweaks, FastQuit, InvMove) to enhance gameplay comfort without compromising efficiency.
 
4. Stable Architecture: Optimized mixin handling ensures a rock-solid, crash-free environment straight out of the box.
